title: Functions report input
description: Structured source evidence for the deterministic functions-outline renderer.

files.description: Defining source files. Paths must be unique after slash normalization.

path.description: Structural path containing all directory segments and the defining filename.

language.description: Optional explicit language or file-type label for ambiguous headers, extensionless scripts, and other paths that filename inference cannot classify correctly.

proposal.description: Marks a file that an explicit proposal would add or remove. The renderer changes only the directly enclosing folder's matching figure by one.

constants.description: Named source constants rendered with the reserved neon-pink system color.

types.description: Named classes, structs, enums, actors, records, unions, aliases, and object or JSON-like shapes rendered with the reserved dark-red system color.

capabilities.description: Explicit named behavioral contracts such as protocols, interfaces, traits, and comparable abstract contracts. Do not use for merely duck-typed objects.

macros.description: Named preprocessor macros and comparable explicit macro declarations.

extensions.description: Named source augmentation scopes rendered as expandable groups, such as Swift extensions, Objective-C categories, or explicit module/prototype augmentations.

callable.description: A named callable. It renders as a leaf when it has no nested source collections and as an expandable group when it owns reportable local declarations.

signature.description: Real source-level name and actual parameters, including empty parentheses when applicable.

proposal.description: Marks a proposed addition or removal and changes only its immediate structural parent's matching figure by one.

returns.description: Material source-supported return type or result shape, without the arrow prefix.

isTest.description: Set true when source inspection identifies this callable as a test. Only the top change summary counts its proposal under Tests instead of Functions; tree appearance and counts are unchanged. Omitted or false means an ordinary callable.

description.description: Concise responsibility only when the signature is not self-explanatory.

uses.description: Architecturally important implicit dependency or side effect.

updates.description: Architecturally important state mutation or persistence effect.

constants.description: Relevant named immutable values declared inside this callable.

types.description: Relevant named types declared inside this callable.

capabilities.description: Relevant named behavioral contracts declared inside this callable.

macros.description: Relevant named macro declarations structurally owned by this callable.

signature.description: The real source-level declaration or compact defining shape.

proposal.description: Marks a proposed addition or removal and changes only its immediate structural parent's matching figure by one.

description.description: Concise responsibility only when the declaration is not self-explanatory.

signature.description: Real source augmentation declaration, such as `extension RecordingBackend` or `AudioRecorder (Writer)`.

proposal.description: Marks a proposed extension addition or removal and changes only the defining file's matching figure by one.
